Python loads on your first run.

Define solve_ik(q, target). Call record(q) after accepted updates, then return six joint angles. Your draft stays in this browser.

What do the helper functions do?
task(q, target)
Returns the selected task error and its Jacobian. Position is divided by 0.4 m; orientation is a rotation vector in radians. The orientation Jacobian includes the log-map derivative.
kinematics(q)
Returns position, rotation, J. J is the world-aligned geometric 6×6 Jacobian: linear rows first, angular rows last.
converged(q, target)
Position error below 0.1 mm and, in pose mode, orientation error below 0.1°.
record(q)
Copies a pose for playback. Shape, finite values and the classroom joint interval are checked.
lower, upper, np
Joint search intervals and NumPy. Wrist 3 is physically continuous; its ±360° interval here is a numerical classroom choice.

SMALLEST σ—

POSITION RANK—

Using Jv / L for position and [Jv / L; Jω] for full pose, with L = 0.4 m. Scaling changes the numerical condition estimate, not rank. Rank threshold: σ > 10⁻⁷ σmax.

SWEEP WRIST 2 THROUGH ALIGNMENTOther joints held fixed
PSEUDOINVERSE GAIN · 1 / σmin—
DLS GAIN · σmin / (σmin² + λ²)—

These gains describe the weakest singular direction before clipping or backtracking. A pseudoinverse discards a direction below its cutoff; damping does not restore a missing degree of freedom.

The optional 3D ellipsoid shows position velocity directions only, with axis ratios normalized for display. It cannot show all six pose dimensions. A wrist singularity may leave this 3D ellipsoid full-sized.

THREE CONNECTIONS TO MAKE

01

Wrist alignment

At wrist 2 = 0°, the wrist axes align and the full-pose Jacobian loses rank. Switch to position-only mode: losing an orientation direction does not necessarily remove a position direction.

02

A straight elbow

At elbow = 0°, the arm reaches an aligned configuration. Inspect the full-pose singular values, then bend the elbow a little. A local rank loss and a globally unreachable target are different problems.

03

Damping is a tradeoff

DLS reduces amplification in weak directions. More damping can make updates smoother or slower; it cannot make every target reachable. Compare the same start, target and task when comparing solvers.

Real Python + NumPy runs locally through Pyodide. Three.js renders official UR3 and Robotiq meshes. This exercise uses nominal, uncalibrated kinematics and a fixed open gripper. It does not simulate contact, collision avoidance or gripper closure. Native Pinocchio is used for reference validation, not as the browser runtime.
